name: comp-374

frames.best_why: Menu is fully open with icons, shortcuts, submenu arrows and the red Delete row visible.

tagline: A button drops a dark menu of icon actions, shortcuts and two submenus.
summary: An outlined button opens a dark dropdown with a New action, two submenus for Framework and Notifications, plus Share, Archive and a red Delete. Icons and keyboard shortcuts sit beside the labels.
appearance: A dark rounded menu appears under an outlined 'Rich menu with icons' button. Rows are left-aligned with small grey icons; New and Delete carry right-aligned shortcut badges, Framework and Notifications end in right chevrons, and Delete is tinted red. Thin rules group the rows.
behaviour: Clicking the button opens the menu. Hovering Framework or Notifications opens a side panel with radio choices for frameworks and checkboxes for email and push. Choosing an option updates its state and closes the menu.
demo_content: Trigger 'Rich menu with icons'; rows New, Framework, Notifications, Share, Archive and Delete.
search_phrases: menu with icons and keyboard shortcuts
dropdown with submenus and radio choices
action menu with delete in red
button that opens choices like new share archive
use_when: A toolbar action needs a menu that mixes simple commands, toggles and grouped choices.
avoid_when: Nested submenus add depth and can be fiddly to reach on small touch screens.
customise: The menu items, icons, shortcuts and submenu options are written in the file; the framework and notification values are local state you can rewire.
weight_why: A short menu with two optional submenus; no continuous animation.

a11y.note: Radix gives arrow-key navigation, focus-visible styles and real menu roles; purely decorative icons are hidden from screen readers.

issues: The trigger says 'Rich menu with icons', which describes the demo, not the menu's purpose.
Menu items have no actions wired; selecting them only closes the menu.
polish_why: Crisp standard dropdown with clear grouping; no custom flourish and unwired actions.
title: Rich Icon Dropdown
